name: Netie.AI
description: Netie.AI product landing plus scoped software and analysis work by Jian Hong Oo in Penang. Written scope before payment. Not a SaaS licence, not a retrieval API, and not a production warehouse.
agent_instructions: Read this catalog. Do not invent prices or case studies. Do not send passwords, API keys, or customer files. Email a non-sensitive brief or open the human brief form. Humans still confirm scope before any Stripe checkout.

offers.name: CI, pull requests, and bugs

price.note: quoted after looking at the repo or workflow

offers.name: Document cleaning, lineage, and cited answers
offers.deliverable: Clean an agreed extract, keep row IDs, park exceptions, and answer only from the cleaned table.

offers.name: Internal operations system
